Talent0_2Ability.name: Courage Burst
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: In combat, if a part is destroyed, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>. If a target is destroyed, gains an additional <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>. <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf> stacks up to <color=#F74848>10</color> times. At end of action, deducts <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Courage Burst
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: In combat, if a part is destroyed, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>. If a target is destroyed, gains an additional <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>. <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf> stacks up to <color=#F74848>10</color> times. At end of action, deducts <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>. When attacking with a Chainsaw, ignores <color=#F74848>7.5%</color> of the target's Armor for every <color=#F74848>1</color> hit. Resets after attacking.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101302.name: Presence
101302.SpecificEffects: If unable to retaliate in combat, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-10%</color>. Gains an additional <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>.

101303.name: Perseverance
101303.SpecificEffects: When any part suffers overdamage, triggers <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking at <color=#F74848>1</color> HP. This effect has a <color=#F74848>3</color>-turn trigger interval.

101304.name: Zealous Blow
101304.describe: Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG. Targets the part with the lowest HP. When there are <color=#F74848>4</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>, gains an additional <color=#F74848>3</color> hits.

101305.name: Fearlessness
101305.describe: Gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP and an additional <color=#F74848>4</color> stacks of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

101306.name: Spirit Strike
101306.describe: Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.6x</color> DMG. Prioritizes damaged parts. When there are <color=#F74848>8</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>, can perform a Gusty Strike <color=#F74848>2</color> times, with the second attack dealing <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> DMG.

101307.name: Onward!
101307.SpecificEffects: When action starts, if there are no enemies within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, gains <buf ID=7100901>[Movement UP]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

101308.name: It's a Miracle
101308.describe: Gains <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks of <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf>, <buf ID=7102005>[DMG Taken Down III]</buf>, <buf ID=7100305>[DMG UP III]</buf>, and <buf ID=7100901>[Movement UP]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can continue action with full Movement.

101309.name: Inevitable Slash
101309.describe: Attacks a target with a Chainsaw, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5x</color> DMG. If the target's HP is below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, this attack cannot be dodged.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100031.name: Alacrity 1
100031.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a Melee Weapon, has a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> following the enemy's attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100034.name: Alacrity 2
100034.SpecificEffects: Before an Active Attack, the probability of triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

100035.name: Alacrity 3
100035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>.

100036.name: Alacrity 4
100036.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.

101341.name: Defiant Warrior 1
101341.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf> is at <color=#F74848>3</color> or more stacks, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101344.name: Defiant Warrior 2
101344.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf> is at <color=#F74848>5</color> or more stacks, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

101346.name: Defiant Warrior 4
101346.SpecificEffects: When action ends, <buf ID=1013503>[Vigor]</buf> is not deducted.
